name: kb_assassination_rogue
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's Assassination list: Envenom at one combo point, then Slice and Dice at one, Eviscerate at five with Cold Blood first, Noxious Assault as the only builder. Rupture, Backstab and Sinister Strike are the KB's never-list; its AoE advice stays single target, the opener and Vanish's threat reset and Thistle Tea are named in kb.unexpressed. The preset is the combat rogue's list with this file in place of rogue_combat.
